name: Lucius masters the Katana
description_md: A Deck About Evading, Succeeding by X, and Mastering the Katana The concept is simple: Build around the mighty [Katana](/card/10021) — but it's a bit trickier than it seems. The Core Challenge - Lucius has a base combat of just **1**. - To trigger the Katana’s bonus, we need to **succeed by exactly 2**. - Lucius **can’t include** **Guardian** cards. The Solution: Clever Tools and Synergies To meet the deck’s unique demands, we turn to a clever mix of assets, skills, and deck tech. Worth mentioning: - [Versatile](/card/06167) lets us grab the pieces we normally couldn’t access. Precision Boosts These help us hit the sweet spot of succeeding by exactly 2: - [Eye of the Djinn](/card/07225) + [Occult Reliquary](/card/10132) - [Artistic Inspiration](/card/11034) - [Steady-Handed](/card/10053) - [Inquisitive](/card/11101) - [Book of Verse](/card/11005) - [Daring Maneuver](/card/03030) - Maybe even a spicy [Blasphemous Covenant](/card/07113) When the Math Doesn't Work Succeeding **by exactly 2** is a tight window. If we miss it, we still have a powerful backup: - [Gray's Anatomy](/card/09058) gives us a reliable damage boost, even when Katana’s effect isn’t triggered. - [The Raven Quill](/card/09042) makes Gray's easier to find and use: - No hand slots - No AoO from using the tome - An extra use of an exhausted asset — potentially [Katana](/card/10021)! With a full setup, Lucius can swing at **8** agility, making the Katana’s attack a real threat. --- Every Other Card? Mostly here for smoother setup: - Draw, resources, asset acceleration, and minor healing (especially via Gray’s) Special Mentions These support consistency and tempo: - [Friends in Low Places](/card/09060) - [Black Market](/card/08055) - [No Stone Unturned](/card/03307) - [Glimpse the Unthinkable](/card/05318) - [Backpack](/card/53011) --- It’s an unusual deck with a narrow combat window, but when it works — it *really* works. Sleek, stylish, and just a little bit sharp.
